test: the freeze on disk is the one Phase 6 was built against
detail: the same assertion the scoring instrument makes at S0a. A watch governed by a different freeze is watching the wrong thing

test: the pin parses to the twenty names and the cutoff
detail: read THROUGH THE SCORING INSTRUMENT'S OWN PARSER, so this watch checks the names that run will actually assert on

test: the 2026-27 E0 file is obtainable from the source
detail: https://www.football-data.co.uk/mmz4281/2627/E0.csv - source last modified Mon, 31 Aug 2026 22:42:25 GMT. Written to data/watch/, which is gitignored and which no scoring code reads. data/raw/ is untouched

test: the file parses as CSV and carries a header
detail: the column COUNT is not asserted against a fixed number on purpose: football-data adds and drops bookmakers between seasons and always has. What matters is the columns this project names, below

test: the 12 match-detail columns the project uses are present under the same names
detail: imported from phase5_e1a_sot_ratings.SHOT_COLUMNS rather than retyped, so this checks the list the code actually uses: HS, AS, HST, AST, HC, AC, HF, AF, HY, AY, HR, AR

test: the spine columns the join and the market cross-check need
detail: PRESENCE only. FTHG, FTAG and FTR are named here and are never loaded - see FORBIDDEN and SW2b

test: Bet365 closing (PRIMARY) - B365CH, B365CD, B365CA
detail: the PRIMARY book is the one H6.2(c) freezes. Losing it would cost the holdout its market control, which is the whole point of scoring the market on the same matches

test: market average closing (sensitivity) - AvgCH, AvgCD, AvgCA
detail: declared a SENSITIVITY in PHASE5_MARKET_PREDECLARATION.txt. If it is gone, the sensitivity cannot be reproduced on 2026-27 and that is reported as a loss of scope, NEVER repaired by promoting another book into its place

test: Pinnacle closing (sensitivity) - PSCH, PSCD, PSCA
detail: declared a SENSITIVITY in PHASE5_MARKET_PREDECLARATION.txt. If it is gone, the sensitivity cannot be reproduced on 2026-27 and that is reported as a loss of scope, NEVER repaired by promoting another book into its place

test: no result column is loaded into memory
expected: none of FTHG, FTAG, FTR, HTHG, HTAG, HTR, HxG, AxG
detail: usecols=SAFE_COLUMNS is what makes 'this instrument cannot leak' a property of the file rather than a promise in its header. Asserted rather than assumed, because the promise is the part that rots

test: the project's two copies of TEAM_MAP agree
detail: phase5_market_benchmark and phase5_e1a_sot_ratings each carry one. A watch that checked the wrong copy would pass while the scoring run failed

test: every 2026-27 team name maps into the pin's twenty
detail: THE MAPPING IS THE PROJECT'S OWN DICTIONARY, applied whole and never by partial match. A name outside the vocabulary is exactly what P4.5 says must stop the scoring run, and the fix is a DATED AMENDMENT to the pin recording the source's actual spelling - never a normalisation inside a loader. Source names seen: Arsenal, Aston Villa, Bournemouth, Brentford, Brighton, Chelsea, Coventry, Crystal Palace, Everton, Fulham, Hull, Ipswich, Leeds, Liverpool, Man City, Man United, Newcastle, Nott'm Forest, Sunderland, Tottenham

test: distinct team names in the source file so far
detail: fewer than twenty early in a season is not a defect - it means not every club has appeared yet. Only names that fail to map are

test: every row is the Premier League
detail: a division column carrying anything else means the wrong file

test: every date parses as %d/%m/%Y
detail: the format is the one load_odds() uses. A source that switched to ISO would raise inside the scoring run instead

test: no match date is in the future
detail: a fixture list with results attached would carry unplayed dates

test: the row count is consistent with the matchweeks played
detail: a matchweek is a block of match dates separated from the next by at least 4 days, derived from the file's OWN dates rather than from a calendar this repository does not hold. The tolerance absorbs postponements; a larger drift means rounds are being split or merged and the count needs looking at

test: the season has not overrun its structural bounds
detail: the hard bound, as opposed to SW8b's tolerance. Breaching it means the file is not one Premier League season

test: no club has played more than 38 matches
detail: a count above 38 means duplicated rows, which is the failure mode M1a caught on the development files

test: matches played per club
detail: a spread wider than a match or two mid-season means postponements, which move rows across the cutoff under H3.4 and change the 360

test: columns present in E0_2526.csv and gone from 2026-27
observed: 32: BMGMH, BMGMD, BMGMA, CLH, CLD, CLA, LBH, LBD, LBA, PSH, PSD, PSA, P>2.5, P<2.5, PAHH, PAHA, BMGMCH, BMGMCD, BMGMCA, CLCH, CLCD, CLCA, LBCH, LBCD, LBCA, PSCH, PSCD, PSCA, PC>2.5, PC<2.5, PCAHH, PCAHA
detail: REPORTED, NOT ASSERTED. A dropped column this project does not use costs nothing; the row exists so that a source narrowing is visible in September rather than inferred in May. SW5 is the assertion

test: columns new in 2026-27
observed: 14: HxG, AxG, PPH, PPD, PPA, SKBH, SKBD, SKBA, PPCH, PPCD, PPCA, SKBCH, SKBCD, SKBCA
detail: A NEW COLUMN IS NOT AN INVITATION. H5.1 forbids any feature decision made because of something observed in 2026-27, and that includes a column that appears mid-holdout. Recorded for after the holdout is scored, and not acted on

test: the pin declares the E0 file as the 2026-27 spine
detail: AMENDED 2026-09-03. This row used to report a gap: the scoring instrument read a spine built from an FBref export in data/raw/Fixtures/, which arrives only at season end and could not be checked in advance by anything. Section 7 of the pin declares the E0 file instead, on the strength of M1b/M2a/M2b/M3 of phase5_market_audit.csv - two independently sourced spines agreeing on every date and every scoreline across all 1,900 development matches. Every input the scoring run has is now the file this watch checks monthly

test: the FBref export the declaration replaces
detail: kept as a row because P7.6 says what is lost: the development seasons had TWO sources agreeing, and a single-source spine has no such cross-check. If 2026-2027 PL Season.xls appears at season end it is to be reconciled against the E0 spine as a CHECK and never used as the spine - a run that can silently pick either source is a run whose vocabulary and row count depend on which one it picked

test: the previous watch run
observed: no earlier run - this is the first
detail: monthly is the declared cadence, from the freeze to the final 2026-27 fixture. Each run writes its own dated artefact rather than overwriting one, so the record is a series of checks at dates and not a single mutable file
